title: Six-Bedroom Hillside Villa with Roof Decks & Terraced Infinity Pool
note: Gated estate · 24/7 security · Fully staffed · Private chef available
sleeps: up to 12 guests · 6 en-suite king bedrooms
blurb: A three-level white-and-glass villa stepping down a wooded hillside above a coral cove — six en-suite king bedrooms including a penthouse master with its own sun deck, a long infinity pool overlooking the Gulf, and roof decks made for sunset.
detail:
Stacked in three levels down a wooded hillside above a quiet coral cove, this villa is built for groups who want space and privacy in equal measure. Pale stone, white render and floor-to-ceiling glass give it a calm, contemporary profile, with green roofs and terraces softening every edge and the Gulf of Thailand opening out beyond the treetops.

The living level is one long, open room — a deep sofa lounge, a dining table that seats the whole party, and a kitchen island with a bar — with sliding glass walls that pull back onto the pool terrace. The infinity pool runs the length of the house and appears to spill into the sea, with loungers set right at the edge; after dark the water and the terraces light up, and the whole villa glows.

Six king bedrooms, each with its own en-suite, are spread across the lower two levels and the top floor, where the master occupies a penthouse suite with a private sun deck of its own. Bathrooms carry oversized tubs and rain showers, and several rooms open straight onto garden or pool terraces. Multiple roof decks add quiet corners for morning coffee or sunset drinks.

A television lounge with a centralised sound system, an office, a walled landscaped garden, private parking and full backup generators complete the house, with complimentary wireless internet throughout and uniformed security on the gated estate. Choeng Mon's calm bay and Chaweng's restaurants and nightlife are both a short drive away.
